changes.comment: Remove `detectDelimiter`, `parseRecordsWithLines`, and `LineRow` from the public surface; `CsvScanner` now takes the shared options object and owns chunk buffering with lazy delimiter auto-detection (`createCsvGridStream` is a thin adapter); single-character delimiters are enforced with `TabulaParseError`; async schemas in `parseTypedRecords` now raise `TabulaParseError`.
